takeout.title: Takeout
takeout.lead: Orders by phone only, (613) 592-0225. If the line is busy, try again.
takeout.hoursLead: Takeout hours are not the same as dine-in.
takeout.openHours: Takeout is also available during open hours, within this window.
takeout.beer: Beer and wine are also available for takeout.
takeout.pickup: Standard pickup is 15–20 minutes for most orders; some take longer. Orders can be pre-ordered up to an hour prior to pickup.
takeout.pay: Cash, Interact, credit cards including American Express, and payment over the phone if you ask when ordering.

events.title: Events
events.lead: Looking to host a business lunch or dinner, a wedding shower or rehearsal dinner? We have an exclusive hosting space in the upstairs loft.
events.seats: The loft seats up to 32 people for seated lunches and dinners.
events.menus: We offer a variety of set menus and specialty menu items for groups.
events.email: Email the event team at events@fratelli-kanata.ca.
events.gratuity: Groups of 8 or more are subject to an automatic gratuity of 20%.
events.cake: Outside desserts will be subject to a plating fee reflective of the group’s size.

about.title: About
about.glebe: Established in 1996 in the Glebe, their vision was a neighbourhood restaurant with good Italian food, good wine, and friendly service in an unpretentious atmosphere. Robert and mother Louisa ran the kitchen; Richard and father Pasquale worked the dining room.
about.kanata: We continue as fratelli. Kanata is the family-owned restaurant on Terry Fox Drive. Westboro is now in Westboro.
about.roberto: Roberto Pizza in Little Italy is a different kitchen. Here’s their site.
about.notWestboro: Kanata is 499 Terry Fox Drive. Westboro is 275 Richmond Road.
about.twoLocations: Westboro is 275 Richmond Road — OpenTable or (613) 722-6772. Kanata is 499 Terry Fox Drive — tables by phone, (613) 592-0225.
